title: Ember and Sigil
author: Gideon Dravenmoor
blurb: Sebastian Brightwater, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
